verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a public REST API with Bearer token auth that can read, create and change content. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 spec, an interactive try-it reference, a TypeScript SDK and documented rate limits, and the current Beta API has a dated migration path to a successor portal. The probe's 404s were on docs.capacities.io paths, while the spec is hosted at api.capacities.io, so they do not contradict the documentation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use; Beta-to-new-API transition stability unproven.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Capacities API is a REST API that allows you access, create and manipulate your content.
The Capacities REST API gives you programmatic access to a workspace space — read and write objects, properties, block content, daily notes, and more.
The Capacities API uses Bearer authentication (token-based authentication, OAuth 2.0 RFC 6750).
If you need programmatic access to the API specification, you can download the OpenAPI 3.0 Specification
Install the Capacities TypeScript SDK: npm install @capacities/api
